chronologyNote.finding: Structured sources use inception 1100, while secondary historical sources generally place construction in the first half of the twelfth century. The previous categorical claim 'before 1100' was stronger than the retrieved evidence and has been replaced with a cautious around-1100 or early-twelfth-century formulation.
